candidate_source: Vpick scenes, descriptions, transcripts, and timestamps
candidate_generation: scene_i and scene_i-1 plus scene_i bridges

selector.name: b2_anchor4_intrinsic_v2_augment
steps: Run B2 adaptive coverage and preserve ranks 1 through 4.
Split the scored candidate pool into five timeline bins.
Within each bin, combine hierarchical candidate prior 75% and intrinsic Listwise Judge 25%.
Add the highest-ranked non-overlapping intrinsic candidate as rank 5.
If no candidate is eligible, refill from the remaining B2 candidates.

development_evaluation.universe: 17 longforms and 18 common Gold pairs with Vpick baseline

validation_limit: Development-only and non-blind because the current Codex thread had previously seen some Gold timestamps. A new-longform blind holdout is required before a final performance claim.
forbidden_claims: This is a blind holdout result.
The 25% Judge weight is generally optimal.
The text-only Judge directly evaluates thumbnail, facial expression, audio tone, or caption effects.
The Vpick comparison covers every Gold pair.
